description: Compact and efficient. Living bright bedrooms dim. Deep — views through multiple spaces. No internal corridor — fully open layout. Kitchen: L-shaped or U-shaped, no island or peninsula — counter set back from windows, moderate natural light. Cook faces the wall — back to the living and dining area. Two cooks can work simultaneously on separate counter runs. Fully open plan — no wall separates kitchen from dining and living. Living arrangement: split seating-kitchen-dining, kitchen on side wall. Seating: An L-shaped sofa in the lower-left living area faces toward the centre of the room and the TV on the left wall; additional seating around the central area. Dining table (4 seats). TV on wall left of entry. Cook cannot see TV from cooking position. Diners do not face the TV. Entry: direct into living, first thing visible on arrival is living area. No door between entry and living — relevant where local regulations require separation. Double bedroom — accessed via through living, no walk-in wardrobe. Master bedroom is only accessible through the living room — no direct corridor access, least private position. Double bedroom closest to entry — lighter acoustic separation from the arrival zone. Storage: one wardrobe. One bathroom (shower, bathtub, and toilet). Single bathroom — all household members share one shower, sequential morning routine. Suits: singles or couples. Not suitable for: families with children; households needing two private bedrooms; anyone wanting a separate enclosed kitchen; people needing a home office with privacy.
not_suitable_for: anyone wanting a separate enclosed kitchen
people needing a home office with privacy
